title: Diamond Duplication
description: This Mod adds a "Carbon Ore" which when 2 are combined with 1 diamond in a crafting table makes 2 diamonds.
body: This Mod adds a "**Carbon Ore**" to the game and it allows you to duplicate diamonds using 2 carbon and 1 diamond and it has a chance to replace granite and andesite and it is a useful mod for servers to get diamonds a bit easier but you need to get a _diamond pick_ to mine the ore.
